description: Update Prompt defaults: weekly updates, minor and patch updates grouped, major updates separately, security fixes right away

packageRules.description: One weekly PR with all minor and patch updates. Major updates keep their own PRs, because they can break things and need their own review.
Indirect Go modules too. Renovate skips them by default, so a fix in a module like golang.org/x/net would wait until a direct dependency pulled it in.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflows and composite actions, marked with a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line above
